final: WITH status_stats AS (SELECT sites.healtheval, SUM(scans.scancount) as total_scans, SUM(scans.gbsize) / SUM(scans.spanmin) as gb_per_minute FROM scans JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sites.healtheval), avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) as avg_gb_per_minute FROM status_stats) SELECT status_stats.healtheval, status_stats.total_scans, status_stats.gb_per_minute, status_stats.gb_per_minute - avg_calc.avg_gb_per_minute as excess_over_average FROM status_stats CROSS JOIN avg_calc WHERE avg_calc.avg_gb_per_minute IS NOT NULL AND status_stats.gb_per_minute > avg_calc.avg_gb_per_minute ORDER BY status_stats.healtheval
